content.text: Cameroon [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-explained-digital-creators|Digital Product]] product creators are locked out of Stripe, PayPal, and other conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-what-actually-how|payment]] gateways, leaving them without a reliable way to sell ebooks, courses, and other digital products to international buyers. The problem is not the platform, but the infrastructure. The solution is to deploy a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-which-architecture-actually-3|COREMERCH guide to sovereign]] digital commerce stack that uses Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments to process payments and store orders. This is not a workaround, but a base-layer infrastructure that gives creators full control over their commerce operations.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Selling Digital Products from Africa: The Complete Infrastructure Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-africa-step-step-deployment-guide. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

You can deploy a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing using the Edge Commerce Stack, which includes Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. This stack is designed to get you up and running in 48 hours, with 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end testing. You can also load 3 products on the Sovereign Starter Stack, which includes GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

The minimum viable stack that works for Cameroon digital product creators is a combination of Cloudflare Pages, NOWPayments, and Supabase. This stack provides automatic crypto payment processing, order storage, and file delivery, all without requiring a Stripe or PayPal account. You can deploy this stack using the Edge Commerce Stack or the Sovereign Starter Stack, both of which are designed to get you up and running quickly.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

You don't need to worry about setting up a Stripe or PayPal account when you deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack. You also don't need to worry about configuring complex payment gateways or dealing with foreign exchange fees. With NOWPayments, you can accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, including USDT on Tron, which settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10.
You can deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack in Cameroon and start selling digital products to international buyers in under 48 hours.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

Creators in Ethiopia, Cameroon, Tanzania, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, and the Philippines face a compounded challenge: not only are conventional payment platforms unavailable, but local banking infrastructure may add additional friction to receiving international transfers through alternative channels. Crypto payments remove this layer entirely. A seller in Addis Ababa and a seller in Amsterdam receive USDT transactions through the same NOWPayments infrastructure, at the same speed, with the same 0.5% fee. The blockchain has no knowledge of which country a wallet is located in. The webhook fires to both backends identically. Geographic neutrality is not a feature — it is the fundamental property of how blockchains work.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

The Edge Commerce Stack that COREMERCH deploys most frequently combines Cloudflare Pages for storefront hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend webhook handling and order processing, Supabase for order storage, Resend for transactional email delivery, and NOWPayments for crypto payment verification. The total monthly cost is zero. The scale ceiling is significantly higher than what most individual creators need — Cloudflare Workers handles 100,000 requests per day on the free tier, Supabase provides 500MB of PostgreSQL storage, and Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month. For a creator in any country on earth, this stack provides the same infrastructure as a well-funded e-commerce operation at no monthly cost.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Global access through sovereign infrastructure works because every layer of the stack is geography-neutral by design. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront from data centers close to your buyer — whether they are in London or Lagos, the page loads in under 200 milliseconds. NOWPayments generates a unique payment address for each transaction — the buyer sends crypto from any wallet, anywhere in the world. The blockchain confirms the transaction regardless of which country the sender is in. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook and processes the order using the same logic for every buyer.
You don't need to worry about setting up a Stripe or PayPal account when you deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack.

If you're looking for more infrastructure solutions to expand your digital commerce reach, consider the Complete Builder Kit, which includes all 6 blueprints plus all 7 templates. Everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack is included. You can also shop for other products at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these steps: Deploy the Edge Commerce Stack or the Sovereign Starter Stack using Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. Load your products and configure your payment settings. Test your payment flow and make sure everything is working correctly. Accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, including USDT on Tron, using NOWPayments. Store orders in Supabase and deliver files using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2.
